imports_destino_ck.name: imports_destino_ck
imports_destino_ck.value: ("finance"."imports"."alvo" = 'conta' and "finance"."imports"."account_id" is not null and "finance"."imports"."card_id" is null and "finance"."imports"."statement_id" is null) or ("finance"."imports"."alvo" = 'cartao' and "finance"."imports"."account_id" is null and "finance"."imports"."card_id" is not null and "finance"."imports"."statement_id" is not null)

installment_plans_destino_ck.name: installment_plans_destino_ck
installment_plans_destino_ck.value: ("finance"."installment_plans"."origem" = 'cartao') = ("finance"."installment_plans"."card_id" is not null) and ("finance"."installment_plans"."card_id" is null) <> ("finance"."installment_plans"."account_id" is null)

outbox_pendente_idx.name: outbox_pendente_idx
outbox_pendente_idx.where: published_at IS NULL AND dead_at IS NULL

recurrences_dia_ck.name: recurrences_dia_ck
recurrences_dia_ck.value: "finance"."recurrences"."dia" between 1 and (case when "finance"."recurrences"."frequencia" = 'semanal' then 7 else 31 end)

transactions_account_fitid_uq.name: transactions_account_fitid_uq
transactions_account_fitid_uq.where: "finance"."transactions"."fitid" is not null and "finance"."transactions"."account_id" is not null

transactions_card_fitid_uq.name: transactions_card_fitid_uq
transactions_card_fitid_uq.where: "finance"."transactions"."fitid" is not null and "finance"."transactions"."card_id" is not null

transactions_destino_ck.name: transactions_destino_ck
transactions_destino_ck.value: ("finance"."transactions"."account_id" is null) <> ("finance"."transactions"."card_id" is null) and ("finance"."transactions"."card_id" is null) = ("finance"."transactions"."statement_id" is null)

transactions_transferencia_ck.name: transactions_transferencia_ck
transactions_transferencia_ck.value: ("finance"."transactions"."tipo" = 'transferencia') = ("finance"."transactions"."transferencia_sentido" is not null and "finance"."transactions"."transferencia_par_id" is not null) and ("finance"."transactions"."transferencia_sentido" is null or "finance"."transactions"."transferencia_sentido" in ('saida', 'entrada'))
